summary.zh-TW: 圖片框固定、框裡的畫面移動得比頁面慢，旁邊的文字移動得比頁面快，三種速度疊出前後的距離感。往回捲時方向相反。
summary.en: The image frame stays put while the picture inside drifts slower than the page and the text beside it moves faster — three speeds that create depth. Scrolling back reverses it.

text.zh-TW: 圖片框裁掉超出的部分，框裡的畫面比框高 40%（上下各多 20%）。畫面在框裡上下移動，才不會露出空白。
text.en: The frame clips overflow, and the picture inside is 40% taller (20% extra top and bottom), so it can move without revealing gaps.

text.zh-TW: 正數：移動得比頁面慢，感覺在遠處；負數：比頁面快，感覺在近處。速度寫在 HTML 上，改數字就能調，不用改程式。
text.en: Positive values move slower than the page and feel far away; negative values move faster and feel close. Speeds live in the HTML, so tweaking needs no code.

text.zh-TW: 從元素剛出現在畫面底部，到完全離開畫面頂部，這整段捲動都在移動。視差才會連續，不會突然開始或停止。
text.en: Movement spans from the moment the element enters at the bottom to when it leaves at the top, so the parallax never starts or stops abruptly.

text.zh-TW: 視差一定要等速：捲多少就移多少。用 expo 之類的 ease，捲動和畫面移動會對不上，看起來像卡頓。
text.en: Parallax must be linear — move exactly as much as you scroll. An ease like expo makes scrolling and movement drift apart and feel janky.

text.zh-TW: 視差強度要節制，10～20% 就夠，太大會讓人頭暈。這裡把畫面的移動限制在框能容納的範圍內。
text.en: Keep parallax subtle — 10–20% is plenty; more can make people feel seasick. The picture’s travel is clamped to what the frame can hold.
